build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template where two balls must touch despite obstacles using define_task_template decorator
create_dynamic_balls: create two dynamic balls in the scene using C.add with set_center_x and set_bottom positioning
add_static_obstacles: add static bar obstacles with configurable scale, angle, and position using C.add and set methods
update_task_relationships: update the task goal by setting body1, body2, and TOUCHING spatial relationship via C.update_task
set_solution_tier: set the solution tier metadata to TWO_BALLS using C.set_meta for task categorization
